description: Design or review the application architecture and API contract.
---

Design the smallest maintainable architecture that satisfies the challenge brief.

Use the repository instructions and the actual challenge files as the source of truth.

Deliver:
- frontend/backend folder structure;
- database entities, relationships, constraints, and indexes;
- candidate and HR API endpoints with request/response examples;
- authentication/authorization boundaries;
- scoring-job state machine and retry/idempotency strategy;
- audio upload storage and metadata approach;
- local development and test strategy.

Explain trade-offs and identify anything that is optional. Do not implement code until I approve the design. Do not add infrastructure without a clear need.
